name: sparx — Record Shop (Vintage)
tagline: A warm, working storefront for a vintage record shop.
description: A complete, working shop for a warm neighbourhood record store: a real catalogue of vinyl LPs across the classic genres, a walnut turntable, a felt slipmat, a cleaning kit, a canvas tote and a monthly vinyl subscription, with categories, collections, a bespoke record-counter PDP and a full merchandised home page. Warm, nostalgic theme — faded-paper ground, burnt-sienna primary, dusty-teal accent, a vintage display serif. Shipped as Sunset Sounds.
